# fpprobe: lines that differ between C libraries and System.Math

369 lines compared, 55 differ somewhere. c-ucrt: native clang + UCRT (Windows); c-glibc: native clang + glibc 2.43 (WSL Ubuntu); cs-*: fpprobe.csproj (System.Math) on .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0.33 (tiered and TieredCompilation=0), .NET 10.0.14 on Windows, .NET 8.0.31 and 10.0.13 under WSL. n/a: the API does not exist on that runtime. The C column functions: round_even=rint, round_away=round, min/max=fmin/fmax, rem=fmod (C# % = CIL rem), ieeerem=remainder, maxnumber=fmax, scaleb=scalbn, bitdec=nextafter(x,0).
